release_name: LANDeploy v2.1.1 — Group Chat Fixes & Management
release_notes: Fixed group creation bug when server IP was not configured
Added group deletion with server-side cleanup of messages
Right-click context menu on groups: View Details, Copy ID, Delete
Group details modal showing creator, security, and participant info
Auto-detect loopback server and save config on beacon discovery
Includes all v2.1.0 Windows 11 compatibility fixes
